question: Which GR sets MahaIT's current rates for supplying technical manpower to departments?
gold_answer: The GR of 22-04-2020, with rates for 01-04-2020 to 31-03-2021: the latest in this corpus. It follows the rate GRs for 2018-19 (03-04-2018) and 2019-20 (09-04-2019). No newer rate GR in this corpus

gold_grs_detail.title: Rate for Supply of IT Human Resources by Maharashtra Information Technology Corporation for period 01/04/2018 to 31/03/2019.
Regarding revised Pay Scale for making technical manpower available for the period from 01-04-2019 to 31-03-2020, from Maharashtra Information Technology Corporation.
Renewal rate of Technical Manpower of Maha IT for year dated 01/04/2020 to 31/03/2021.

product.answer: The current rates for supplying technical manpower to departments are set by the 22-04-2020 GR (202004221243514111), which fixes rates for 01/04/2020 to 31/03/2021 via an annexure; earlier GRs set rates for 2018-19 and 2019-20. No later GR in the corpus amends these current rates.

product.answer: The GR dated 03-04-2018 (code 201804031521270211) originally set the rates for supplying technical manpower from 01/04/2018 to 31/03/2019 as per the attached Annexure. Later GRs in 2019 and 2020 amended this by adding a condition that Maharashtra IT Corporation shall issue work orders based on the availability of technical manpower of institutions mentioned in Annexure-I as per the agreement with supplying agencies.
